visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a young male character named Andy sitting in the driver's seat of a parked car. He has short black hair and is wearing a black ribbed sweater. He is looking down at his smartphone, held in his hands, with a focused expression. The background shows the interior of the car and blurred daylight through the windows. (2) The scene cuts to a high-inference shot of a traditional Taiwanese street food menu board with blue and red borders. It lists various soups and rice dishes like milkfish soup and peanut oil rice. A man in a grey shirt is partially visible in the bottom right, attending to the stall. (3) Andy is back on screen in the car, holding a yellow plastic food container. He carefully opens a small plastic pouch and pours a dark brown liquid sauce over a bowl of rice. His hands are in a medium close-up, and his face shows anticipation. (4) An extreme close-up focuses on the peanut oil rice. The dish consists of white rice topped with small chunks of braised pork fat and peanuts, now glistening under the dark sauce. (5) Andy uses wooden chopsticks to pick up a large mouthful of the rice. He eats with exaggerated facial expressions, opening his mouth wide and closing his eyes in delight. Yellow variety text overlays flash on screen as he reacts. (6) A shot of a bright red storefront sign for 'Red Wheat Field Fried Chicken' appears, showing the location in Beigang. (7) Andy is shown in the car holding a large, golden-brown fried chicken drumstick wrapped in a white and red paper bag. He takes a huge bite, looking directly into the camera with wide eyes to show his reaction. (8) A brief shot displays multiple fried chicken legs on a metal cooling rack at a stall, with a worker's hand in purple gloves visible in the background. (9) Andy continues to eat the chicken, gesturing with his free hand while pointing at the crispy skin. He appears to be explaining the taste and texture with an energetic and satisfied demeanor until the video concludes.
